{"checkedFacets":["Company challenge fit: need for 14-day raspberry shelf life with <1% Botrytis mould, micro-condensation inside heat-sealed rPET punnet, OTR/CO2TR matching to berry respiration at 2–4 °C, translation of measured headspace/permeability data into a film specification, modest trial budget", "Each candidate's declared domain vs the challenge's actual domain (soft-fruit MAP/berry spoilage packaging science)", "Explicit identity bindings and contentLinks for every content evidence excerpt (author_of / project_participant / patent_inventor / profile_field)", "Participation restrictions: open_to, notes (availability, leave, lab access, schedule constraints) and industry_experience for all eight candidates", "Attribution completeness: unattributedEvidenceIds and IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED diagnostics", "Term-overlap / lexical-anchor artefacts in matchedFields (e.g. 'heat sealed', 'seal', 'condensation' matching unrelated mechanical-seal or enclosure work)", "Whether candidate outputs include quantified mould/Botrytis incidence endpoints under simulated transit", "Whether declared equipment/instruments exist in profile evidence"]}

{"checkedCandidates":["R0976","R0715","R0926","R0426","R0172","R0786","R1044","R0084"]}

{"findings":[

{"id":"F1","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E014","E072","E012","E094","E011","E142","E007","E124","E074","E127"],"code":"DOMAIN_MISMATCH_LEXICAL_SEAL","severity":"blocking","explanation":"R0926 (Sofija Ristić) matched the pool on the tokens 'sealed', 'seal' and 'condensation', but every inspected content record concerns sealing technology for outdoor/electromechanical enclosures: condensation risk inside sealed steel enclosures with a heat-dissipating PCB (E014/E072), IP54 enclosure moisture ingress (E012), polyurethane vs EPDM cabinet gaskets (E094), thermal-gradient 'breathing' in partially sealed enclosures (E011), and project MOISTMOD (E142/E007, project SYN-PRJ-0361). Nothing inspected addresses food packaging, modified atmosphere, gases, respiration, Botrytis or soft fruit. Her declared scope is gasket/O-ring/IP-rating/reliability engineering, and her restrictions are limited to enclosure and systems-integrator partners (E074) with enclosure-manufacturer consulting (E127) and availability only from early 2026 (E124). Any statement that she offers transferable 'condensation modelling' for a berry punnet is a keyword artefact; the physics and materials differ and no perishable-food validation exists in the inspected evidence.","recheckQuestion":"Can any registered evidence show perishable-food or MAP packaging work by R0926, rather than enclosure gasket/condensation physics?"},

{"id":"F2","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E035","E118","E003","E034","E049","E032","E162","E083","E106","E038","E160","E144"],"code":"DOMAIN_MISMATCH_LEXICAL_SEAL","severity":"blocking","explanation":"R0786 (Svetlana Sabo) matched on 'condensation', 'sealed', 'seal', 'anti-condensation' and 'hygrothermal modelling', but the inspected records are enclosure/device physics: polycarbonate electronics housings (E035), ABS outdoor housings under winter conditions (E118), meteorological-data-driven outdoor enclosure dew-point workflow (E003), substation electrical cabinets with vapour ingress through cable glands (E034), PV junction-box sensitivity analysis (E049), book-chapter mechanics of mechanically sealed enclosures and silicone gaskets (E032), hermetic optoelectronic assemblies (E162), and EPDM/silicone/TPU gasket permeability (E083). Keywords (E106) are 'sealed enclosures', 'elastomeric seals', 'enclosure climate'. Her industry experience is outdoor metering cabinets (E160), and her stated preferences are real hardware/field validation with spring–summer campaigns (E144). No inspected record covers produce respiration, headspace gas composition, OTR-per-respiration matching or fungal spoilage — so a 'condensation modelling' role for a raspberry punnet is unsupported by the inspected evidence.","recheckQuestion":"Is there any registered evidence of R0786 modelling condensation or vapour transport in a perishable-food package rather than a service enclosure?"},

{"id":"F3","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E100","E002","E172","E108","E016","E111","E148","E176","E010","E163"],"code":"DOMAIN_MISMATCH_LEXICAL_SEAL","severity":"blocking","explanation":"R0426 (Aleksandar Bošković) ranked 4 via terms 'mould', 'packing', 'pressures', 'heat' and 'sealed'. In context, 'mould' is injection-mould tooling and heat transfer coefficient, 'packing' is packing pressure during injection, and 'pressures' is melt/clamping pressure: E100 (interfacial HTC effects on warpage of PA6 boxes), E002 (packing pressure vs crystallinity/warpage), E172, E108 (differential mould cooling and warpage of PP brackets), E016 (mould cooling-circuit CFD), E111 (two-component PP/PA6 overmould residual stress). His declared fields (E148) and open_to (E176) are injection-moulding thermomechanical simulation; his lab cannot do in-house injection moulding and his tools are licensed (E010). Misreading 'mould' as Botrytis mould or 'packing' as produce packing would be a serious keyword artefact; no evidence inspected concerns food spoilage or packaging gas atmospheres.","recheckQuestion":"Does any registered evidence link R0426 to food packaging, gas atmosphere or microbial spoilage rather than injection-moulded part warpage?"},

{"id":"F4","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E134","E027","E047","E039","E102","E146","E045","E145","E150","E110","E008","E159","E022"],"code":"DOMAIN_MISMATCH_LEXICAL_SEAL","severity":"blocking","explanation":"R0715 (Bojan Grbić) matched on 'heat seal', 'seal', 'film' and 'sealed'. All inspected outputs are seal-layer polymer engineering for high-speed VFFS lines: seal-initiation temperature vs comonomer (E134), seal-layer thickness/hot-tack window (E027), formulation lowering jaw temperature (E047), peel vs burst acceptance criteria (E039), film ageing and seal strength (E102), seal heat-transfer FE model (E146), and a seal-layer blend patent (E045/E145), plus project SYN-PRJ-0586 (E150). Nothing inspected addresses anti-fog lidding films on rPET punnet trays, OTR/CO2TR design against respiration, headspace composition, or mould incidence. His stated preference is access to production-scale extrusion equipment because his cast-film line is limited (E110), and his open_to items are seal-layer formulation, VFFS line qualification and converter/resin-supplier projects (E008), with converter-focused industry experience (E159) — a poorer match to a punnet lidding-film specification problem than a claim of 'film and sealing expertise' would imply.","recheckQuestion":"Can any registered evidence show R0715 work on lidding-film permeability, tray lidding, or produce-packaging outcomes rather than pouches on VFFS lines?"},

{"id":"F5","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E099","E068","E137","E120","E022","E103","E143","E115","E017","E031","E104","E042","E044"],"code":"DOMAIN_MISMATCH_BIOMATERIALS","severity":"blocking","explanation":"R0084 (Petar Dobanovački) matched on 'humidity', 'materials', 'testing' and 'shelf life'. The inspected record set is biomedical/engineering-polymer durability: PEI dimensional tolerance loss in humidity-controlled storage (E099/E022), SLS PA12 fatigue after hygroscopic cycling (E068), TPU catheter tube ageing protocols (E137), DMA screening of humidity-aged PA6/PA66-GF30/POM-C/PEEK (E120/E103), PEEK in simulated body fluid (E143). His only link to the challenge's permeability theme is participating in the PERMTEMP gas-permeability reference-data project (E115/E017/E031), which is not evidence of produce-packaging or Botrytis work. His restrictions point to medical-device accelerated ageing, polymer-components, biomedical device projects (E042), medical device manufacturer consulting (E044), and semester-limited external testing capacity (E104). Profile bio is empty. Presenting him as a berry-packaging shelf-life specialist would overstate the evidence.","recheckQuestion":"Beyond PERMTEMP participation, is there registered evidence of R0084 applying permeability/ageing work to fresh produce or packaging films?"},

{"id":"F6","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E117","E134","E039","E125","E133","E165","E004","E161","E150","E151"],"code":"DOMAIN_MISMATCH_BIOMATERIALS","severity":"advisory","explanation":"R1044 (Branka Lalić) matched via co-authored seal-film papers and project SYN-PRJ-0586 (E150/E151), but her own first-author work inspected is thermoplastic starch / sunflower-protein blown film (E117, OTR 180–620 cm³/m²/day/bar) and a reactive-extrusion process patent (E125). Her declared fields are biopolymer/thermoplastic starch processing (E133) and her open_to is biopolymer formulation, extrusion troubleshooting and material specification (E165), with packaging-manufacturer and compounding-company experience (E161). She is a secondary co-author on E134 and E039, so her relevance to the berry problem is indirect and mostly carried by others' authorship.","recheckQuestion":"Which registered outputs of R1044 concern polyolefin lidding films or berry MAP rather than starch/protein biopolymer films?"},

{"id":"F7","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E004","E165"],"code":"CAPACITY_UNAVAILABILITY_WINDOW","severity":"blocking","explanation":"R1044 is scheduled for parental leave from October 2026 to approximately April 2027 and can only accept commitments starting before October 2026 (E004). The challenge's own timing is a roughly eight-month season deadline tied to the next export season, and the deliverable is simulated-transit confirmation trials that typically run in autumn/winter after harvest. Depending on how the deliverable window maps onto that leave, she may be unable to support the decisive validation phase; her 5 kg/h extruder throughput also limits pilot scale (E004). This is a concrete participation limit that must be checked against the intended project schedule rather than assumed away.","recheckQuestion":"Does the intended project timeline keep all of R1044's work before October 2026, and who covers characterisation during her leave?"},

{"id":"F8","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E173","E179","E128"],"code":"CAPACITY_UNAVAILABILITY_WINDOW","severity":"advisory","explanation":"R0172 (Snežana Puzović) is stated as available for new collaborations only from autumn 2026 onwards because of MONOBAR supervision commitments, and prefers experimental work at her own laboratory rather than on-site (E173). Combined with the challenge's eight-month, budget-limited timeline, the start date creates a scheduling constraint. Her highly relevant capability — temperature-resolved OTR/WVTR with Arrhenius activation energies (E179, E128) — is real, but availability and laboratory-location preferences must be reconciled with when the simulated-transit trials need to happen.","recheckQuestion":"Can R0172 start early enough for the season deadline, and are her permeability measurements conducted at the Faculty laboratory under the available budget?"},

{"id":"F9","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E110","E144","E104","E124"],"code":"EQUIPMENT_ACCESS_PRECONDITION","severity":"advisory","explanation":"Three of the shortlisted candidates state preconditions or constraints on physical facilities: R0715 requires access to production-scale extrusion equipment because his laboratory cast-film line is limited to 45 mm screw diameter (E110); R0786 reports limited autumn laboratory availability, favouring spring/summer measurement campaigns and real hardware (E144); R0084 reports limited external testing capacity during the academic semester, preferring summer and early autumn (E104); R0926 is only available from early 2026 (E124). For a limited-budget project, these conditions may raise cost (equipment access, rescheduling) or collide with the season timetable. They are not disqualifying but must be explicitly checked.","recheckQuestion":"What production-scale extrusion/lidding access and which campaign windows can be secured within the stated trial budget?"},

{"id":"F10","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E130","E040","E064","E055","E140","E009","E114","E036","E059","E001","E006","E138","E155","E087","E169","E073","E018","E140","E101","E015"],"code":"NO_INSPECTED_MOULD_ENDPOINT_IN_SPECIFIC_FORMAT","severity":"advisory","explanation":"R0976's domain fit is clearly the strongest inspected: Serbian raspberry MAP gas mixes with Botrytis incidence at 2 °C over 14 days (E138), OTR/CO2TR film screening with finite-element permeation modelling and 55% mould reduction (E087), pre-cooling/headspace equilibration effects on Botrytis (E073), a book chapter on MAP design with film permeability selection and worked raspberry line example (E055), Arrhenius/RSL modelling on Serbian consignments (E130) and a digital-twin pilot with Botrytis growth models (E040). Counter-evidence to a naive reading: the quoted mould endpoints are reductions of 55% and 63%, not the challenge's <1% absolute incidence target, and E087 concerns mixed-berry trays at 2 °C, not the specific 125 g rPET shell with anti-fog heat-sealed lidding at 2–4 °C. Nothing inspected demonstrates 14-day sub-1% mould incidence in the challenge's exact format, and her open_to items are industrial PhD supervision and joint projects (E101) with three exporter packaging trials (E015) — no named commercial consulting, though the challenge is a commercial short engagement. Evidence IDs present in the pool for publications E130/E040/E064 are abstracts only, not full-text validation.","recheckQuestion":"Which specific registered evidence shows below-1% absolute Botrytis incidence at day 14 in a heat-sealed 125 g punnet format, rather than relative reductions?"},

{"id":"F11","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E115","E086","E070","E135","E168","E126","E024","E076","E030","E128"],"code":"SCOPE_LIMIT_NONFOOD_BARRIER","severity":"advisory","explanation":"R0172's inspected work is film transport physics and barrier/packaging materials rather than berry shelf-life outcomes: temperature-resolved LLDPE OTR with Arrhenius parameters (E086), production-batch OTR/pinhole statistics with a polyolefin film producer (E070), BOPP crystallinity vs OTR (E135), metallised CPP ageing (E168), layer-by-layer coatings (E126), a high-barrier coextruded film patent (E024), and the PERMTEMP reference dataset through 5–50 °C (E115). Her keywords (E076) include no produce/MAP/spoilage terms, and her industry collaboration is a confidential film producer relationship (E128) that may constrain use of her data. She can supply permeability parameters and measurement capacity, but nothing inspected shows her translating OTR into a punnet-level mould-incidence specification, which is the challenge's core modelling gap.","recheckQuestion":"Does any registered evidence show R0172 delivering a film specification against a microbial spoilage endpoint in fresh produce?"},

{"id":"F12","scope":"run","claimIds":[],"evidenceIds":["E140","E169","E155","E009","E006","E114","E036","E059","E084","E152","E157","E181","E029","E112","E013","E131","E048","E019","E079","E122","E078","E170","E023","E091","E026","E109","E025","E080","E153","E171","E123","E041","E129","E092","E077","E141","E028","E057","E119","E088","E164","E075","E085","E050","E098","E067","E033","E017","E151","E069","E154","E058","E005","E095","E149"],"code":"IDENTITY_ATTRIBUTION_INCOMPLETE","severity":"advisory","explanation":"Attribution is one-sided and partial for every candidate. Every inspected bundle lists IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED diagnostics (a participant with no internal researcher ID) for each multi-author record, so co-authorship by R0976, R0715, R0926, R0426, R0172, R0786, R1044 and R0084 is established only for the listed author index (e.g. E140 for R0976 on SYN-PUB-10216, E131 for R0715 on SYN-PUB-08000, E084 for R0426 on SYN-PUB-05124); contributions by unnamed co-authors, including any external packaging firms, are not transferable to these candidates. Separately, shared evidence IDs (E014/E072/E063 on the joint enclosure paper; E039/E134 sealed-film papers; E150 project) are bound to different candidates, so a single excerpt can support several individuals' authorship but not one individual's exclusive expertise. No unattributedEvidenceIds appeared in any bundle, and profile_fields were bound by registered evidence for all eight.","recheckQuestion":"For each candidate, which specific author-position and project-role bindings are registered, and are any external industrial co-authorship claims resting on unresolved participants?"}

],

"noCounterEvidenceFound":[

"Checked R0172 identity bindings and records for internal contradictions (keywords E076 vs bio E156 vs publications): no conflict found; no identity flags.",
